analysis: Batch 1.2 - law 677 at order 12, open in every source: of the 195 case CNFs, 138 are refuted within 200,000 conflicts with DRAT proofs that drat-trim verified (10.5 million proof lines); 57 remain undecided - 14 idempotent (exactly those whose row 0 has a single fixed point) and 43 non-idempotent (all with 0 in a cycle of length >= 4 and at most 2 fixed points in row 0); no model. The hypothesis is confirmed. The result is a certified reduction of the question to 57 explicit CNFs, not a decision.
